contract: Yalidine, Maystro and legacy ZR capabilities require a current exact connection plus source-reviewed or live-certified evidence
NOEST effects remain disabled until the exact provider-issued endpoint contract is independently certified
credential or endpoint drift invalidates execution authority

queue: POST creates or returns one active run per platform and returns 202
request handlers never fetch provider pages or mutate canonical orders inline
the exact active-shop worker is the only run, page and item executor
pagination: Shopify page_info and WooCommerce/YouCan page cursors are persisted as opaque continuation
every fetched provider page is committed before any item is processed
page budgets yield and requeue without discarding continuation
candidate watermarks retain the maximum observed value across provider page ordering
items: each normalized provider order is encrypted before canonical processing
item identity binds platform, provider order identity and source revision
one leased immutable attempt executes at a time
canonical command replay makes restart after mutation safe
validation conflicts quarantine immediately; retryable faults use bounded generation-scoped retries
providerAuthority: each run stores exact credential and endpoint fingerprints
credential or endpoint drift fails closed before another provider page is fetched
canonical source identity remains integration-stable so provider credential rotation cannot duplicate orders
watermark: the watermark commits atomically only after fetch completion and every item succeeds or is skipped
partial, retrying, quarantined and dead-letter runs retain the previous watermark
terminal watermark conflicts release the active run key so a reconciled new run can be queued
recovery: sanitized run, page, item and immutable-attempt history
reason-bound audited operator retry with fresh automatic retry generations
no decrypted provider payload or customer PII leaves the service boundary
inactive-shop runs remain durable and are not drained
experience: Arabic, French and English queued, fetching, processing, retrying, partial, quarantine, dead-letter, conflict and history states
RTL-safe provider identifiers and keyboard-operable expansion/retry controls
settings Sync now reports durable queueing rather than false synchronous completion

repairs: prevented max-page checkpoint skips by exposing provider continuation
prevented monotonic watermark regression across descending provider pages
bound runs to exact credential and endpoint contracts
released terminal conflict runs for a fresh exact contract
scoped retry budgets by operator recovery generation
kept operator and UI projections PII-free

evidenceBoundary.proven: source, database, migration, integration and development UI
notProven: live commerce-provider behavior with current real stores
